q: By June 30, 2027, North Korean state media announce an ICBM test moratorium and link it to talks or an agreement with the United States
basis: In April 2018 North Korea declared a halt to nuclear and ICBM tests and went on to the Singapore summit in June. On September 21, 2025, Kim Jong Un said he could talk with the United States if Washington dropped its demand for denuclearization, but would not bargain anything away in exchange for sanctions relief. Whether Pyongyang puts a moratorium publicly on the table will show what it wants in return.
rs: A KCNA or Rodong Sinmun statement, or a joint U.S.-North Korean document, that includes language on a moratorium on ICBM (or strategic weapons) tests
